apis.desc: AHU (Ministry of Law) company registry. Given a NIK of a company founder/director, returns the deed of establishment (akta) number, SK Kemenkumham decree number, notary, and deed date. Use for legal-entity fields on permit forms.
BP Batam free-trade-zone. Given a NIB, returns the approved duty-free import masterlist and land allocation (UWTO) status for that business.
Tax authority (DJP). Given a NIK, returns the taxpayer number (NPWP) and the date it was last verified.

Resolve a citizen identity. Given full name and phone number, returns the national ID number (NIK) and registered address. Call this FIRST when a query gives only name + phone — most other APIs need a NIK.
OSS national business licensing. Given a NIK of a company director, returns their registered business: NIB number, company name, KBLI activity codes, risk level.
SATUSEHAT health exchange. Given a NIK, returns blood type, allergies, and details of the last medical checkup (facility, date, notes).
